title: Don't open an issue to report problems with the latest Nightly
body:
If you are experiencing any issues with the latest Nightly, please post in this open issue:
https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/issues/1796

Please DON'T open a new issue.

There is work in progress.  
There is no need to flood the issues platform with more and more new issues.

comments.body: We cannot prevent people doing this but we can enhance the issue template to include a reference to any issues labeled with [build-nightly](https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/issues?q=is%3Aissue+label%3Abuild-nightly).

@Navid200  Since #1796 really doesn't pertain to #1797 except that it is a problem with a latest nightly build, perhaps you should rename the issue "problems with the latest nightly build". 
And #1797 pertains to 2021.08.02, and #1796 pertains to 2021.08.01.

@doc77 It was renamed already by tolo27.
Thanks
